description: The vendors the engine (scripts/) may call and where (D-069 item 7, plan v3.1 R1). Validated by contracts/adapters/engine-vendors.v1.json and read by scripts/lib/vendor_check.py through providers.vendor_catalog. A baseline site is a call outside the adapters that predates the check: its nature and reason for remaining are recorded in baseline_classification; the list only shrinks. Classification does not imply every site must migrate to the forge port. A slot with no caller keeps its detectors, so a new call is refused until its port exists (OU-DECOUPLE F5, D-113).

vendors.name: github
vendors.note: The source of truth since 14/11/2026 (D-314): pull requests, the merge queue and tower/gate live on GitHub, through the gh CLI of the sessions and the hosted job; Origin is a mirror. Beside it, GitHub hosts third-party binary artifacts at the classified toolchain baseline.

scripts/lib/toolchain_manifest.py:github.reason: Builds third-party binary release download URLs; artifact distribution is not a forge operation.

vendors.name: github-actions
vendors.note: The engine's scripts never call GitHub Actions' API (its runs, workflows or jobs). Since D-314 (14/11/2026) the gate itself runs as GitHub Actions jobs: tower/gate, deploy-doorbell and full-suite (.github/workflows/, the gate.allowed_workflows registry key), each running a script of this tree (scripts/verify-commit, scripts/lib/deploy.py). The CI runner port is scripts/lib/adapters/ci_runner.py; its adapter is the local gate runner.

vendors.name: claude
vendors.note: The agent provider today; port scripts/lib/adapters/agent.py.

vendors.name: codex
vendors.note: Documented slot of the agent port (adapters/agent.py SLOTS); no adapter yet.

vendors.name: cursor
vendors.note: Documented slot of the agent port (adapters/agent.py SLOTS); no adapter yet.

vendors.name: cloudflare-r2
vendors.note: No engine caller: the product media storage that used it left the repository (OU-DECOUPLE F4, D-111). The engine's shared store is the aws-s3 vendor (adapter of scripts/lib/adapters/storage.py).

vendors.name: aws-s3
vendors.note: The engine's shared store (DEP8 lambda artifacts in the outputs bucket): the s3 adapter of the storage port, boto3 where importable (Fargate runner), else the aws CLI (CodeBuild deployer).

vendors.name: figma
vendors.note: Design specs. No engine caller since the product that read them left the repository (OU-DECOUPLE F4, D-111).

vendors.name: origin
vendors.note: The new Cursor Origin forge, distinct from the Cursor agent provider. Its port is scripts/lib/forge_events.py; forge_origin.py implements the adapter and forge_origin_client.py transports requests through the origin CLI.
